title: Connect on Hyper-V port 2179.
author: jfkguidant
body_snippet:
I successfully connect to a Hyper-V guest (Windows server 2022) on my own computer. But as soon as I check "Use enhanced mode", the connection fails.
I see the tab opening and closing after a sec.
Is there any log I can provide?

comments.author: jfkguidant
comments.snippet:
Sorry, I'm wrong on that. My rdp port 3389 was opened.
I disabled Remote Desktop connection in settings and now I can't connect.
So problem is: how to connect on port 2179. I read vmrdp.rst. Firewall is deactivated. "Use VM ID" is yes. Hyper-V works, of course.
